summary: Phase 2a (SMMA(20)/SMMA(120) + BUY/SELL crossover) end-to-end verified. Backend: all 37 unit tests pass and 6 new live-API integration tests (tests/test_api_phase2.py) pass against the public URL. Frontend: SMMA20/SMMA120 render '₹<num>' on all 20 rows, Signal column shows bright BUY/SELL pill when API row.signal is set (muted otherwise, '—' only when both null), Active Signals KPI matched the bright-signal row count on the checked snapshot (KPI=1, bright pills=1), signals_status hint reads 'SMMA(20)/SMMA(120) crossover live', ITC detail panel populated numeric SMMA20/SMMA120, Stance BEARISH, Latest Event SELL, Event Time 14:26:37. No console errors during a 10s / 2s polling window. ETQ / AVG-LTP still '—' and Decision still 'Pending' — no fabricated data.

integration_issues.issue: The review request states that the fix 'derives summary client-side from snapshot'. However /app/frontend/src/hooks/useMarketData.js STILL calls GET /api/summary in parallel with /api/snapshot (see line 25). Because backend /api/summary and /api/snapshot each call pipeline.run_once() independently and each call advances the SMMA state one bar, the two responses can disagree — this is exactly the bug the review flagged. The one-off UI check happened to match (KPI=1, bright pills=1), but this is race-prone. Fix: derive nse_universe/price_qualified/liquidity_qualified/active_signals/lifetime_signals from `snap.data` in useMarketData.js and drop the /api/summary call.

action_items: Apply the announced fix: in /app/frontend/src/hooks/useMarketData.js, remove the axios.get('/api/summary') call and derive summary fields client-side from the snapshot (nse_universe=snap.length, price_qualified/liquidity_qualified/fully_qualified computed by filter, active_signals=snap.filter(s=>s.signal!==null).length, lifetime_signals=snap.filter(s=>s.last_signal!==null).length, signals_status static string). This eliminates the race between /summary and /snapshot flagged in the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: pipeline.run_once() is invoked twice per UI poll (once from /snapshot and once from /summary) which advances SMMA state twice and doubles the crossover-event surface area on the server; deriving summary client-side is the right fix.
SymbolState.last_signal_at stored as ISO string is fine, but consider storing as datetime and serializing at edge for consistency with tick.timestamp (which uses datetime).
DEMO_WARMUP_TICKS=150 is executed synchronously in Pipeline.__init__, which extends first-request cold start; consider a lazy warm-up flag or a background task.
seed_data_creation: None — demo provider generates its own ticks.
